description: Issue #8 (2026-10-20). Just after midnight, sums yesterday's consumption over the Energy dashboard's device list (the same long-term statistics it draws; there is no whole-house meter) into input_number.energy_yesterday, the AC share into energy_yesterday_ac, and how many meters reported into energy_yesterday_meters. Also at Home Assistant start, so a restart over 00:10 does not leave the day before yesterday's figures standing (it recomputes the same day; review 2026-10-20). A bucket with no change counts as offline. Read-only: it writes three helpers and nothing else. `ids` must equal the Energy dashboard's device_consumption list (tests/climate/wiring.py checks). No anomaly flag: ten days of history did not support one (docs/energy-digest.md).
